name: codecommit
description: CodeCommit This is the CodeCommit API Reference.

subcommands.name: associate-approval-rule-template-with-repository
subcommands.description: Creates an association between an approval rule template and a specified repository.

subcommands.name: batch-associate-approval-rule-template-with-repositories
subcommands.description: Creates an association between an approval rule template and one or more specified repositories.

subcommands.name: batch-describe-merge-conflicts
subcommands.description: Returns information about one or more merge conflicts in the attempted merge of two commit specifiers using the squash or three-way merge strategy.

subcommands.name: batch-disassociate-approval-rule-template-from-repositories
subcommands.description: Removes the association between an approval rule template and one or more specified repositories.

subcommands.name: batch-get-commits
subcommands.description: Returns information about the contents of one or more commits in a repository.

subcommands.name: batch-get-repositories
subcommands.description: Returns information about one or more repositories.

subcommands.name: create-approval-rule-template
subcommands.description: Creates a template for approval rules that can then be associated with one or more repositories in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-branch
subcommands.description: Creates a branch in a repository and points the branch to a commit.

subcommands.name: create-commit
subcommands.description: Creates a commit for a repository on the tip of a specified branch.

subcommands.name: create-pull-request
subcommands.description: Creates a pull request in the specified repository.

subcommands.name: create-pull-request-approval-rule
subcommands.description: Creates an approval rule for a pull request.

subcommands.name: create-repository
subcommands.description: Creates a new, empty repository.

subcommands.name: create-unreferenced-merge-commit
subcommands.description: Creates an unreferenced commit that represents the result of merging two branches using a specified merge strategy.

subcommands.name: credential-helper
subcommands.description: Provide a SigV4 compatible user name and password for git smart HTTP These commands are consumed by git and should not used directly.

subcommands.name: erase
subcommands.description: This operation does nothing, no credentials are ever stored

subcommands.name: get
subcommands.description: get a username SigV4 credential pair based on protocol, host and path provided from standard in.

subcommands.name: store
subcommands.description: This operation does nothing, credentials are calculated each time

subcommands.name: delete-approval-rule-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified approval rule template.

subcommands.name: delete-branch
subcommands.description: Deletes a branch from a repository, unless that branch is the default branch for the repository.

subcommands.name: delete-comment-content
subcommands.description: Deletes the content of a comment made on a change, file, or commit in a repository.

subcommands.name: delete-file
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified file from a specified branch.

subcommands.name: delete-pull-request-approval-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes an approval rule from a specified pull request.

subcommands.name: delete-repository
subcommands.description: Deletes a repository.

subcommands.name: describe-merge-conflicts
subcommands.description: Returns information about one or more merge conflicts in the attempted merge of two commit specifiers using the squash or three-way merge strategy.

subcommands.name: describe-pull-request-events
subcommands.description: Returns information about one or more pull request events.

subcommands.name: disassociate-approval-rule-template-from-repository
subcommands.description: Removes the association between a template and a repository so that approval rules based on the template are not automatically created when pull requests are created in the specified repository.

subcommands.name: evaluate-pull-request-approval-rules
subcommands.description: Evaluates whether a pull request has met all the conditions specified in its associated approval rules.

subcommands.name: get-approval-rule-template
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specified approval rule template.

subcommands.name: get-blob
subcommands.description: Returns the base-64 encoded content of an individual blob in a repository.

subcommands.name: get-branch
subcommands.description: Returns information about a repository branch, including its name and the last commit ID.

subcommands.name: get-comment
subcommands.description: Returns the content of a comment made on a change, file, or commit in a repository.

subcommands.name: get-comment-reactions
subcommands.description: Returns information about reactions to a specified comment ID.

subcommands.name: get-comments-for-compared-commit
subcommands.description: Returns information about comments made on the comparison between two commits.

subcommands.name: get-comments-for-pull-request
subcommands.description: Returns comments made on a pull request.

subcommands.name: get-commit
subcommands.description: Returns information about a commit, including commit message and committer information.

subcommands.name: get-differences
subcommands.description: Returns information about the differences in a valid commit specifier (such as a branch, tag, HEAD, commit ID, or other fully qualified reference).

subcommands.name: get-file
subcommands.description: Returns the base-64 encoded contents of a specified file and its metadata.

subcommands.name: get-folder
subcommands.description: Returns the contents of a specified folder in a repository.

subcommands.name: get-merge-commit
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specified merge commit.

subcommands.name: get-merge-conflicts
subcommands.description: Returns information about merge conflicts between the before and after commit IDs for a pull request in a repository.

subcommands.name: get-merge-options
subcommands.description: Returns information about the merge options available for merging two specified branches.

subcommands.name: get-pull-request
subcommands.description: Gets information about a pull request in a specified repository.

subcommands.name: get-pull-request-approval-states
subcommands.description: Gets information about the approval states for a specified pull request.

subcommands.name: get-pull-request-override-state
subcommands.description: Returns information about whether approval rules have been set aside (overridden) for a pull request, and if so, the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the user or identity that overrode the rules and their requirements for the pull request.

subcommands.name: get-repository
subcommands.description: Returns information about a repository.

subcommands.name: get-repository-triggers
subcommands.description: Gets information about triggers configured for a repository.

subcommands.name: list-approval-rule-templates
subcommands.description: Lists all approval rule templates in the specified Amazon Web Services Region in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-associated-approval-rule-templates-for-repository
subcommands.description: Lists all approval rule templates that are associated with a specified repository.

subcommands.name: list-branches
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more branches in a repository.

subcommands.name: list-file-commit-history
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of commits and changes to a specified file.

subcommands.name: list-pull-requests
subcommands.description: Returns a list of pull requests for a specified repository.

subcommands.name: list-repositories
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more repositories.

subcommands.name: list-repositories-for-approval-rule-template
subcommands.description: Lists all repositories associated with the specified approval rule template.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Gets information about Amazon Web Servicestags for a specified Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in CodeCommit.

subcommands.name: merge-branches-by-fast-forward
subcommands.description: Merges two branches using the fast-forward merge strategy.

subcommands.name: merge-branches-by-squash
subcommands.description: Merges two branches using the squash merge strategy.

subcommands.name: merge-branches-by-three-way
subcommands.description: Merges two specified branches using the three-way merge strategy.

subcommands.name: merge-pull-request-by-fast-forward
subcommands.description: Attempts to merge the source commit of a pull request into the specified destination branch for that pull request at the specified commit using the fast-forward merge strategy.

subcommands.name: merge-pull-request-by-squash
subcommands.description: Attempts to merge the source commit of a pull request into the specified destination branch for that pull request at the specified commit using the squash merge strategy.

subcommands.name: merge-pull-request-by-three-way
subcommands.description: Attempts to merge the source commit of a pull request into the specified destination branch for that pull request at the specified commit using the three-way merge strategy.

subcommands.name: override-pull-request-approval-rules
subcommands.description: Sets aside (overrides) all approval rule requirements for a specified pull request.

subcommands.name: post-comment-for-compared-commit
subcommands.description: Posts a comment on the comparison between two commits.

subcommands.name: post-comment-for-pull-request
subcommands.description: Posts a comment on a pull request.

subcommands.name: post-comment-reply
subcommands.description: Posts a comment in reply to an existing comment on a comparison between commits or a pull request.

subcommands.name: put-comment-reaction
subcommands.description: Adds or updates a reaction to a specified comment for the user whose identity is used to make the request.

subcommands.name: put-file
subcommands.description: Adds or updates a file in a branch in an CodeCommit repository, and generates a commit for the addition in the specified branch.

subcommands.name: put-repository-triggers
subcommands.description: Replaces all triggers for a repository.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for a resource in CodeCommit.

subcommands.name: test-repository-triggers
subcommands.description: Tests the functionality of repository triggers by sending information to the trigger target.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags for a resource in CodeCommit.

subcommands.name: update-approval-rule-template-content
subcommands.description: Updates the content of an approval rule template.

subcommands.name: update-approval-rule-template-description
subcommands.description: Updates the description for a specified approval rule template.

subcommands.name: update-approval-rule-template-name
subcommands.description: Updates the name of a specified approval rule template.

subcommands.name: update-comment
subcommands.description: Replaces the contents of a comment.

subcommands.name: update-default-branch
subcommands.description: Sets or changes the default branch name for the specified repository.

subcommands.name: update-pull-request-approval-rule-content
subcommands.description: Updates the structure of an approval rule created specifically for a pull request.

subcommands.name: update-pull-request-approval-state
subcommands.description: Updates the state of a user's approval on a pull request.

subcommands.name: update-pull-request-description
subcommands.description: Replaces the contents of the description of a pull request.

subcommands.name: update-pull-request-status
subcommands.description: Updates the status of a pull request.

subcommands.name: update-pull-request-title
subcommands.description: Replaces the title of a pull request.

subcommands.name: update-repository-description
subcommands.description: Sets or changes the comment or description for a repository.

subcommands.name: update-repository-encryption-key
subcommands.description: Updates the Key Management Service encryption key used to encrypt and decrypt a CodeCommit repository.

subcommands.name: update-repository-name
subcommands.description: Renames a repository.
